effective_labels.Description: All of labels (key/value pairs) present on the resource in GCP, including the labels configured through Terraform, other clients and services.

error.Description: The PrivateConnection error in case of failure.

details.Description: A list of messages that carry the error details.

message.Description: A message containing more information about the error that occurred.

labels.Description:
Labels.

**Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the labels present in your configuration.
Please refer to the field 'effective_labels' for all of the labels present on the resource.

location.Description: The name of the location this private connection is located in.

terraform_labels.Description:
The combination of labels configured directly on the resource
 and default labels configured on the provider.

vpc_peering_config.Description:
The VPC Peering configuration is used to create VPC peering
between Datastream and the consumer's VPC.

subnet.Description: A free subnet for peering. (CIDR of /29)

vpc.Description:
Fully qualified name of the VPC that Datastream will peer to.
Format: projects/{project}/global/{networks}/{name}
